query_plan.query: What is the total male population of all countries?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country id, sum the male populations to a total.
steps.query: Return all countries together with their male population, with their country id and country name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT SUM(population_male) AS total_male_population FROM countries

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.name, countries.population_male FROM countries
